claim: The demo EV_RE matches identifiers of the form EV-<8 digits>T<6 digits>-<4 hex chars>.
The demo claim_issues yields an issue when a claim line has no EV identifier.
The demo CLAIM_RE matches PASS, KILLED and n/n ratios case-insensitively.
The demo EV_RE matches identifiers starting with REC-.
The demo claim_issues accepts claim lines without EV identifiers.
The demo CLAIM_RE is compiled with re.I.
